why: The reference output at the end of the pre-Python-migration-fixes campaign (Phase -1 and Phase 0 of the feasibility study). Captured after all six behavioural/hygiene prompts (01-06) and the two 2026-09-05 follow-up commits (5e2b208, 69cae4a) landed. Compare against validation/baselines/pre-fix/ to see exactly what the campaign changed; compare against ~/Documents/Code/LSSEFT/autogenerated/ to see that neither baseline changed a single published number.

git.commit_note: The binary was built from the tip of master (74bc284) at the start of prompt 07, which already carries prompts 01-06 plus 5e2b208 (FabJ closed form) and 69cae4a (zero-valued-Rayleigh assertion). Prompt 07's own commit (which archives this baseline) touches only validation/ and prompts/, no source, so it cannot change the emitted tree -- exactly the same relationship baseline/pre-fix has to its own archiving commit.

command.note: This is NOT the tool's default. --auto-symmetrize is the default and is ~23-26x slower for the same answer; see validation/README.md and validation/ORACLE.md.

captured.run_label: run1 of a five-run byte-reproducibility check performed for prompt 07 (all five runs identical, see logs/07-closeout-and-handover.md)
captured.wall_clock_note: Five sequential runs measured 42.69 / 42.51 / 54.21 / 44.56 / 42.24 s real and 41.18 / 40.70 / 43.39 / 42.15 / 41.25 s user (run 3's higher wall clock is background system load, not attributable to the code -- consistent with the noise band already documented in prompts 02-05's own logs). All five produced byte-identical autogenerated/ trees (validation/check_determinism.sh: PASS, 21/21 non-timestamp files).

contents.autogenerated/: the full emitted tree from the run above
contents.run.log: that run's stdout+stderr, verbatim (ANSI colour codes intact)
contents.warnings.txt: the warning set, ANSI codes and timestamps stripped -- identical to validation/baselines/pre-fix/warnings.txt
contents.counterterm-map.canonical.txt: the ** COUNTERTERM MAP section with each entry's print order canonicalised (validation/canonical_form.py --counterterm-map) -- md5 1c177140d3688e558b445609f8c585a4, identical to validation/baselines/pre-fix/counterterm-map.canonical.txt
contents.counterterm-map.sorted-lines.txt: the same section with the lines merely sorted -- kept for reference, NOT usable for comparison (see validation/NONDETERMINISM.md)

measurements.dedup: 101 emitted, 95 distinct after cancel(together(.)), 6 duplicate pairs -- identical pairing structure to baseline/pre-fix (I-05, unchanged, out of scope)
measurements.note_on_value_md5: This md5 DIFFERS from baseline/pre-fix's 772fdcf3d57d620b0fe9548b738dbc52. That is expected and is issue I-11: commit 5e2b208 replaced the Fabrikant table with its closed form, which changed the printed term arrangement of 47 of the 101 value_ expressions (confirmed count, see logs/07-closeout-and-handover.md) without changing any value functionally. The Wick_ md5 is unchanged, confirming the Wick-product side of the emission is untouched.
